label: Confirmed Deaths
contestNote: Toll rose steadily from 2 (15 Aug) to 73 (19 Aug) as rescue teams reached remote villages; some outlets still cite 68–70 depending on report cutoff date.

label: Displaced / Sheltering
contestNote: Figures climbed from 12,800 (17 Aug) to ~19,000 (18 Aug) to 40,000+ (19 Aug) as assessments reached isolated communities across six regencies.

label: Homes Damaged
contestNote: Some outlets cite ~11,925 total homes damaged (6,463 severe); BNPB's fuller tally spanning severe/moderate/slight tiers is 19,297.

label: Aftershocks Recorded
deltaNote: 24+ exceeding M5.0, 81 felt; BMKG predicts continued activity for 21–30 more days.

label: Mainshock Magnitude
contestNote: GFZ Potsdam measured Mw 7.61 at 25 km depth vs. USGS/BMKG's M7.7 at 10 km; BMKG's own first report was M7.0 before revising upward.
